Name: New Splash Texts
Author: ayden1234kitten
Description:
This mod adds 2326 new custom Splash Texts for the Splash Texts mod.
Warning: There is no filter on the content in the Splash Texts. Be aware that they could contain anything.
Installation: Overwrite the files in the Splash Texts mod folder with the files from this mod.
